evidence.covers: Bitwise: element isotope tables narrowed to binary32; run for 10 formulas; peptide, RNA and DNA averagine estimates; FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked windows 0..80 (limit 20, width 100) with source trimLeft/trimRight; the 12C = 90 % override (limit 1020); public convolve; binary32 renormalize; fragment weights; DBoundingBox intersects (21 steps), touching borders, width and height.

evidence.label: oracle-generated (tier 1 executed differential, repeated executions)
evidence.covers: 200 executions of one SDK binary (../oracle/b2-iso-element-order): EmpiricalFormula iteration order, getLightestIsotopeWeight and run bits for 22 formulas, 81 FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked windows, RNA/DNA estimates at 1000 and 10000 Da, binary32 underflow at 1e5 and 1e6 Da, and insert/trimLeft float narrowing. The element order is not fixed (22 distinct outputs; C1H1N1O1S1P1 iterated H N C O P S in runs 40 and 147, which changed every window from 150 Da up). The port matches the majority output for every natural-element case except Os3Ir3, which differs in every run because the SDK's ElementDB builds iridium from rhenium's tables (ElementDB.cpp:512), and matches the runs that iterated its labelled-isotope placement.
evidence.scope_of_bit_identity: SourceSingle reproduces the executed SDK bit for bit only for runs that iterate the formula's elements in the port's order: ascending atomic number for natural elements (the majority of runs), each labelled isotope after its natural element (no majority). No fixed order reproduces every run. This holds except for formulas containing iridium, which the SDK's ElementDB builds from rhenium's tables (ElementDB.cpp:512); no run reproduces the port for them (Os3Ir3 iterated Os Ir and differed in all 200 runs).

In the B2 fix round, a temporary, uncommitted replica of the reviewer's c2cmp ran on kim against this tree (source precision, trim_left_source with narrowing, trim_right, optional_begin/end, maximum, normalisation) and matched all 15 FFC_1 windows bit for bit in the six C2 records omp1 and omp4 of ffap_ffc1_symmetric, ffap_ffc1_asymmetric and ffap_ffc1_user_seeds.
notes: Each C2 record is one SDK execution. 2 of 200 executions of one binary iterated N before C and changed every window from 150 Da up, so a single-record mismatch can come from the oracle's element order; record or re-execute before attributing it to the port.

Source precision returns Error::InvalidValue when every retained bin underflows binary32 (1e6 Da peptide averagine, limit 20), where the SDK returns NaN; B6 must handle a per-window Err. FFC_1 (maximum 1316.5 Da) cannot reach it.

cpp_issue_candidates: FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked.cpp:163-179 builds abundance overrides by insert() into a default-constructed IsotopeDistribution that already holds (0, 1); executed windows are wrong (30 vs 6 bins).

CoarseIsotopePatternGenerator::run gives different bits in different runs of the same binary. EmpiricalFormula keys atoms by std::map<const Element*, SignedSize> (EmpiricalFormula.h:66), so run (CoarseIsotopePatternGenerator.cpp:114-120) and getLightestIsotopeWeight (EmpiricalFormula.cpp:57-67) iterate in Element address order. Reproduction: ../oracle/b2-iso-element-order/probe.cpp run 200 times; CoarseIsotopePatternGenerator(0).run(EmpiricalFormula("C1H1N1O1S1P1")) iterated H C N O P S in 198 runs (bin 2 intensity 0x3d3540d4) and H N C O P S in runs 40 and 147 (0x3d3540d5); the same runs changed estimateFromPeptideWeight for every FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked window from 150 to 8050 Da. Fix: order the map by atomic number and isotope mass number.
